# Messages

[English](messages.md) | [简体中文](../zh-CN/api-reference/messages.md)

[Back to the API Reference index](README.md)

Unified message sending and message actions.

## Operations on this page

- [`editMessage`](#edit-message): Edit message text
- [`pinMessage`](#pin-message): Pin or unpin a message
- [`reactMessage`](#react-message): Add or remove a message reaction
- [`revokeMessage`](#revoke-message): Revoke a message
- [`sendMessage`](#send-message): Send a message

<a id="edit-message"></a>

## `editMessage`

Edit message text

This operation is currently implemented mainly by providers that support the capability and generally supports text messages only.

| Property        | Value                                                                   |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/messages/edit`                                              |
| SDK method      | `device.editMessage(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["editMessage"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                    |
| Mutability      | `write`                                                                 |
| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                    |

### Parameters

No path, query, header, or cookie parameters.

### Request body

JSON request body.

| Field                  | Required | Type     | Constraints | Description |
| ---------------------- | -------- | -------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| `body.account_id`      | Yes      | `string` | -           | -           |
| `body.conversation_id` | Yes      | `string` | -           | -           |
| `body.message_id`      | Yes      | `string` | -           | -           |
| `body.content`         | Yes      | `string` | -           | -           |

### Responses

| HTTP status | Content-Type       | Schema                  | Description                                                                |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`       | `application/json` | `ResponseMeta & object` | The operation succeeded.                                                   |
| `400`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request body or parameters are invalid.                                |
| `401`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The API key is missing or cannot be validated.                             |
| `409`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.              |
| `500`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | An internal server error or an unmapped error in the provider integration. |
| `501`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The current provider does not support this capability.                     |
| `502`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | This capability is unavailable for the current provider.                   |

The SDK returns `ApiResult<T>` with `data`, `status`, an optional `requestId`, and the underlying `response`.

Success status `200` response fields:

| Field                           | Present | Type      | Constraints | Description                                                            |
| ------------------------------- | ------- | --------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `result.data.request_id`        | No      | `string`  | -           | The request ID generated by the server.                                |
| `result.data.client_request_id` | No      | `string`  | -           | Echoed when the client supplies a valid `X-Request-Id` request header. |
| `result.data.data`              | Yes     | `OkData`  | -           | -                                                                      |
| `result.data.data.ok`           | Yes     | `boolean` | const=true  | -                                                                      |

### TypeScript example

```ts
const result = await device.editMessage({
  body: {
    account_id: "acc_xxx",
    conversation_id: "conversation_xxx",
    message_id: "message_xxx",
    content: "Example text"
  }
});
console.log(result.data.data);
```

<a id="send-message"></a>

## `sendMessage`

Send a message

| Property        | Value                                                                   |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/messages`                                                   |
| SDK method      | `device.sendMessage(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["sendMessage"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                    |
| Mutability      | `write`                                                                 |
| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                    |

### Parameters

No path, query, header, or cookie parameters.

### Request body

JSON request body.

| Field                                      | Required                        | Type                                                                                        | Constraints                                                           | Description                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `body.account_id`                          | Yes                             | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.to`                                  | Yes                             | `Recipient`                                                                                 | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.to.id`                               | Yes                             | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | The provider-side recipient ID.                                       |
| `body.to.type`                             | Yes                             | `ConversationType`                                                                          | enum="user", "group", "channel"                                       | -                                                                     |
| `body.message`                             | Yes                             | `MessagePayload`                                                                            | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.type`                        | Yes                             | `string enum("text" \| "image" \| "video" \| "audio" \| "document" \| "file" \| "contact")` | enum="text", "image", "video", "audio", "document", "file", "contact" | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.text`                        | No                              | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.url`                         | No                              | `string (uri)`                                                                              | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.file_url`                    | No                              | `string (uri)`                                                                              | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.file_key`                    | No                              | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.caption`                     | No                              | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.contacts`                    | No                              | `Array<ContactCard>`                                                                        | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.contacts[].name`             | Required when parent is present | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.contacts[].phones`           | No                              | `Array<ContactPhone>`                                                                       | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.contacts[].phones[].number`  | Required when parent is present | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.contacts[].phones[].type`    | No                              | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.contacts[].emails`           | No                              | `Array<ContactEmail>`                                                                       | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.contacts[].emails[].address` | Required when parent is present | `string (email)`                                                                            | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.contacts[].emails[].type`    | No                              | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.contacts[].organization`     | No                              | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.message.contacts[].title`            | No                              | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.provider_data`                       | No                              | `FreeFormObject`                                                                            | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.reply_to`                            | No                              | `ReplyTo`                                                                                   | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.reply_to.reply_token`                | Required when parent is present | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | An opaque handle from `data.message.reply_token` in an inbound event. |
| `body.mentions`                            | No                              | `Array<Mention>`                                                                            | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |
| `body.mentions[].id`                       | Required when parent is present | `string`                                                                                    | -                                                                     | -                                                                     |

### Responses

| HTTP status | Content-Type       | Schema                  | Description                                                                |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`       | `application/json` | `ResponseMeta & object` | The message send request has been accepted or completed.                   |
| `400`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request body or parameters are invalid.                                |
| `401`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The API key is missing or cannot be validated.                             |
| `409`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.              |
| `500`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | An internal server error or an unmapped error in the provider integration. |
| `501`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The current provider does not support this capability.                     |
| `502`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | This capability is unavailable for the current provider.                   |

The SDK returns `ApiResult<T>` with `data`, `status`, an optional `requestId`, and the underlying `response`.

Success status `200` response fields:

| Field                           | Present | Type                | Constraints | Description                                                            |
| ------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `result.data.request_id`        | No      | `string`            | -           | The request ID generated by the server.                                |
| `result.data.client_request_id` | No      | `string`            | -           | Echoed when the client supplies a valid `X-Request-Id` request header. |
| `result.data.data`              | Yes     | `SendMessageResult` | -           | -                                                                      |
| `result.data.data.message_id`   | Yes     | `string`            | -           | -                                                                      |
| `result.data.data.account_id`   | Yes     | `string`            | -           | -                                                                      |
| `result.data.data.status`       | Yes     | `string`            | -           | -                                                                      |
| `result.data.data.provider_ref` | No      | `string`            | -           | -                                                                      |

### TypeScript example

```ts
const result = await device.sendMessage({
  body: {
    account_id: "acc_xxx",
    to: {
      id: "recipient_xxx",
      type: "user"
    },
    message: {
      type: "text",
      text: "Hello from UnifyPort"
    }
  }
});
console.log(result.data.data);
```
